name: – Tomáš Zdechovský – § 93/2
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the European Public Prosecutor’s Office for the financial year 2023
part_text: ‘calls on the Hungarian government to join the EPPO without further delay; recalls the collection of 680 000 signatures in favour of joining the EPPO, underscoring a strong societal demand for enhanced legal safeguards against fraud and corruption affecting the Union’s financial interests;’
